SnakeList logo: pick one

Two updates to the logo SnakeList has now. Both keep the snake S with its spots, the same greens and the rattlesnake tick. They make the snake a little bigger, give it a clearer head and eye, and clean up the spots. The tick is about 12% smaller with more room before it, and "List" is brighter on dark grounds. Everything below is a screenshot of the real site, the first row as it is today and then with each option.

  • Same snake S and spot pattern
  • Same green colours
  • Same rattlesnake tick (diamonds + rattle)
  • Same lettering

A

Option A: light touch

Closest to today

Same snake, same spots, same rattlesnake tick. The spots are cleaner and no longer blur into each other. The head is about 10% bigger, with a thin dark edge where it lies on the coil and a bigger eye with a tiny shine. The S is a little taller. The tick is about 12% smaller with more room before it, so the snake S leads. In light mode the name is a shade deeper green; on dark grounds (dark mode, opening photo) "List" is brighter so it stands out.

Option B: bolder

Stronger at small sizes

Everything in A, pushed further. The head is about 7% bigger (a touch smaller than A) with a clear eye, and the forked tongue sticks out a bit further. The spots are a little darker, and the S is taller again. The tick is about 12% smaller, so the snake S leads. The name is a deeper forest green in light mode, "List" is brighter on dark grounds, and the app icon sits on SnakeList's own dark green.
